description:
Perform a fluid-structure interaction assessment to determine blade deflection. 

1. Open QBlade and load the 'HAWT_Test.wpa' sample project from '/home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/'. (If 'HAWT_Test.wpa' is not available, use any project with a HAWT rotor).
2. Navigate to the Rotor BEM Simulation module.
3. Run a simulation at a Wind Speed of 12 m/s to generate aerodynamic loads.
4. Navigate to the Blade Stress / Static Analysis module.
5. Import the loads from the 12 m/s simulation into the structural module.
6. Run the Static Deflection analysis.
7. Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/deflection_report.txt' containing the following exact format:
   Wind Speed: 12 m/s
   Max Deflection: <value> m
   Root Moment: <value> Nm
